requirement.zh: 简化三层电梯：目标楼层 targetFloor(1..3) 的上升沿触发；电梯运行到目标楼层(对应 floorSensor 为 TRUE) 后停止并开门 3 秒。上下方向由目标楼层与当前楼层比较决定。
requirement.en: Simplified 3-floor elevator: a rising edge of targetFloor(1..3) starts motion; the car stops when the target floor sensor is active, then opens the door 3s. Direction is up/down by comparing target and current floor.

meta.scenario: 运动控制电梯，目标楼层 + 到位检测 + 开门延时，考查状态机与方向判定。

pous.name: Elevator
